mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School, and keep your eyes peeled for the ISS tonight as it travels from the northwest near Verona High School toward the northeast near Home Depot, remaining low near the horizon.
The City of Verona has announced that city buildings will be closed on November 26 and 27 for the Thanksgiving holiday, with refuse and recycling pickup delayed until Friday.
Enjoy live music today at Bailey's Run, and tomorrow you can check out yoga at Insight Wellness before a busy week of trivia nights starting on November 25.

Looking at the police report from November 2, officers were dispatched to the 100 block of West End Circle regarding a domestic disturbance that resulted in an arrest for battery and disorderly conduct.
Culver's is serving up OREO Cookie Overload for the flavor of the day, and with doors open until 10 PM, it is a perfect time to stop by for a scoop.
